statements.statement: The procedure code billed was CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring)
The diagnosis codes submitted were I47.1 and I25.10
The patient presented with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The symptoms were consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient had a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The service was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances in an outpatient setting
The denial reason code was CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization before services were rendered
